verdict.rationale: Perplexity publishes a machine-readable OpenAPI spec (openapi.json) and structured API docs (quickstart, building-agents guides) that would typically power an interactive reference, but the evidence pack never explicitly shows a 'try it' playground or runnable code examples within the docs UI. missing for 10: explicit interactive 'try it now' console screenshots/docs, confirmation of runnable code snippets executed in-browser, independent user report of using the interactive reference.
